### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. congenital anomalies of kidney and urinary tract 1  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.664)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:29043)

**Proposed mechanism:** DSTYK loss-of-function variant —DISRUPTS→ DSTYK (HGNC:29043); DSTYK (HGNC:29043) —DISRUPTS→ Receptor tyrosine kinase activity regulation (REACT:R-HSA-1908630); Receptor tyrosine kinase activity regulation (REACT:R-HSA-1908630) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal kidney development (HP:0000077); Receptor tyrosine kinase activity regulation (REACT:R-HSA-1908630) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal urinary tract development (HP:0000078). Loss-of-function mutations in DSTYK disrupt its role in regulating receptor tyrosine kinase activity, which is critical for proper kidney and urinary tract development.

**How to falsify it:** Absence of loss-of-function variants in DSTYK in individuals with either disease, or identification of distinct causal genes for each disease that do not converge on a shared pathway downstream of DSTYK. _(variant: A pathogenic loss-of-function variant in DSTYK with a gnomAD allele frequency > 0.01% would falsify its role as a rare disease gene.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the role of DSTYK in kidney and urinary tract development could lead to novel therapeutic targets for congenital anomalies of the kidney and urinary tract (CAKUT) and potentially other DSTYK-related developmental disorders.
